name: pepper

interface.longDescription:
Pepper helps you understand your money in plain language. Connect your Nigerian bank and fintech accounts, check balances, review transactions, and see where your money goes.

Ask about your spending, income, and account activity in ChatGPT. Pepper currently provides read-only access to your financial data. You can manage connected accounts and revoke access from your Pepper account.

Built by AndaLabX.

description: Understand balances, transactions, spending, and income from your connected accounts.
